rubric.evidence_equivalence: Existing evidence criteria allow equivalent fact paths across the whole final report. A missing hypothesis reference alone does not make otherwise supported causal content false.
rubric.explicit_integration: Whether the explanation explicitly connects the capacity restoration control is a separate, stricter diagnostic; do not silently use it as a new root-accuracy requirement.
rubric.final_assertions: Read hypotheses, explanations, source facts, gaps, actions and pending actions. An affirmative gap can assert a cause even if the main hypothesis is tentative.
rubric.confirmation: Tentative candidates and intermediate drafts are not final wrong confirmations. Unsupported or false affirmative final statements are recorded separately.
rubric.unknown_success: Preserve uncertainty, identify discriminating missing information, and propose a concrete discriminating next step under the existing score_run formula.
rubric.diagnostic_scope: Reviewers can use all acquired public evidence and add references. Missing author references do not by themselves invalidate a supported proposition.

rubric.nonapplicable_booleans: Unestablished condition/chain fields on mechanism-only or unidentifiable cases are false encodings, not wrong-root counts; each metric uses its own eligible stratum.

truth.rationale: 实际Semaphore在固定30任务同步突发、持有参数20ms、获取期限100ms条件下运行40→4→40，每次仅容量4产生6次超时，恢复40后消失；三个重复以及smooth容量4零超时对照支持受控局部根因。该实验不涉及SQL/远端数据库，也不验证旧版作者合成回放。
truth.reference_root: 在本地受控实验中，容量从40缩为4，与同步突发30任务、持有参数20ms及获取期限100ms共同造成排队并发生资源获取超时；40容量前后对照均无超时，smooth容量4同样无超时。
truth.allowed_boundary: 只评价本地程序在声明观测窗的请求获取失败。组织why、真实生产负载、SQL、远端数据库进程是否崩溃均不由此确认。私有逐请求等待数据可校核真值，但不能要求模型已看到这些被扣留字段。
